nina: follow-up from RFC: trying a tokenwise-clamp strategy for quant profiles. quick findings from staging run.

devin: what did you see?

nina: repeated separators (e.g. "---") cause the tokenwise EMA to blow out, leading to underflow in int4 allocations. p99 latency +8% for those fingerprints.

ops_kat: saw similar in prod shadow: cache churn when bitwidth transitions mid-session. KV prefix mismatch alerts fired.

sam_t: proposed mitigation: clamp tokenwise updates against cohort percentile. config idea:
```
tokenwise_clamp:
  ema_alpha: 0.15
  clamp_percentile: 90
  max_step: 1.4
  stall_tokens: 6
```

infra-bot: note redis shard limits; hot-shard top-5k fingerprints only.

devin: cheaper fingerprint: murmur3 on first 12 tokens. collisions acceptable.

nina: runtime rules: if clamp triggers too often for a fingerprint -> promote attention layers to int8 for that cohort. add header `x-precision-fallback: cohort_int8` and invalidate session cache on header change.

ops_kat: add telemetry tags: profile_id, cohort_fp, clamp_trigger_count. ops playbook: pause cohort if clamp_trigger_rate > 5% over 5m.

sam_t: SDK/API exposure? keep internal-only for now; enterprise opt-in later.

nina: action items:
- sam_t: telemetry + header invalidate hook (ETA tomorrow)
- devin: implement clamp percentiles and shard lookup (ETA 48h)
- ops_kat: add playbook + alerting (ETA EOD)

nina: will draft a compact RFC note describing schema extension for tokenwise clamps and cohort sharding. please review when posted.
